currency.description: Three-letter currency code for the product price.

shop.description: Identifier or name of the shop offering the product.

items.description: Array of products returned for the current page.

count.description: Number of product items included in this response page.

maxPageSize.description: The most rows one page can hold.

pageSizeCapped.description: Indicates whether the requested page size exceeded the maximum allowed limit and was capped.

query.description: Search term applied to filter the product results, or null if no filter was provided.

nextPageToken.description: Opaque cursor token to fetch the subsequent page of products, or null if there are no more pages.

description: Paginated list of products matching the query criteria.
